elements.manual_reason: No candidate covers exactly 'do it all.': b05 is only 'do', b02/b04 cover part of it plus empty space, b03 includes 'to'; b01 is used for the outgoing pill.
elements.label: Closing words 'do it all.'

pattern.description: Final step of the option-pill wheel: the last pill 'Draft a meeting agenda' rises and blurs away, and instead of another pill the plain-type completion 'do it all.' rises into the slot and sharpens, turning the stem into the full sentence 'One AI tool to do it all.'.
pattern.why_premium: The cycle resolves by dropping the UI chrome, so the payoff line lands as clean typography in the same rhythm as the preceding options, giving a clear end to the list without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.pill-stack', {y:'-=pillPitch', opacity:0, filter:'blur(8px)', duration:0.25, ease:'power2.inOut'}); tl.fromTo('.payoff', {y:40, opacity:0, filter:'blur(8px)'}, {y:0, opacity:1, filter:'blur(0px)', duration:0.25, ease:'power2.out'}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:220}}); pills: translateY = -p*pitch, opacity = 1-p, blur = 8*p px; payoff text: translateY = interpolate(p,[0,1],[40,0]), opacity = p, blur = 8*(1-p) px.

notes: The outgoing pill is gone by the end frame, so b01 (union of changed area, matching its footprint at the slot) is used for it. 'do it all.' stays slightly lighter than the stem at the end frame, maybe still finishing its fade or styled lighter.
